scientific_scope: independent confirmation only for the exact frozen C077-A high-tail conditional goal-difference component P(D|T,X), t>=7. This confirmation cannot solve exact-tail q(k|T>=7), cannot generate a unified score matrix and cannot change formal_weight by itself.

estimand.equivalent_parameterization: H=(T+D)/2; model P(H=h | T=t,X), h=0..t, then D=2H-T
estimand.support_guarantee: candidate support H=0..T mechanically enforces T/D parity and nonnegative integer H,A

baseline.family: exact-T pooled Dirichlet-smoothed empirical P(H|T) from training rows only
baseline.support: H=0..T; unseen training T falls back to uniform legal support

candidate.family: cross-T shared conditional binomial goal-allocation model
candidate.p_model: SimpleImputer(median) + StandardScaler + LogisticRegression(C=0.1, solver=lbfgs, max_iter=2000, class_weight=null, random_state=0)
candidate.fit_likelihood: exact binomial likelihood via T Bernoulli goal-allocation trials per match, with H home-goal successes and T-H away-goal failures

confirmation_source_selection.stage: zero-label source audit only before any confirmation score values are decoded/materialized
required_independence: zero match-identity overlap with C077-A development labels
zero match-identity overlap with C075-C consumed external labels
zero match-identity overlap with C075-E consumed external labels
zero match-identity overlap with C076-D sealed 4567 pool
zero match-identity overlap with C074-G viewed 2025-26 labels
source/provider or source-file family must not be one of those confirmation/development label sources unless an exact disjoint-source adjudication is established before score access
selection_may_use: score-field presence/nullness without decoding numeric score values
confirmation_source_selection.coverage_failure_decision: STOP_COVERAGE_CONFIRMATION_LABELS_CONSUMED; do not replace identities or lower gates after label open

known_ineligible_source_candidates.reason: numeric score rows were exposed during pre-contract source exploration in the active research conversation, so it is not eligible to serve as pristine C077-B confirmation evidence

training_and_scoring_rule.candidate_parameters: exactly frozen C077-A algorithm and C=0.1; no refit of hyperparameters or representation choices from confirmation labels
training_and_scoring_rule.within_confirmation_history: strict chronological PIT feature construction; target-match and future results cannot enter features
training_and_scoring_rule.same_day_rule: all same-day targets are predicted from information strictly available before that day/target cutoff before any same-day outcome update
training_and_scoring_rule.confirmation_time_blocks: must be frozen from zero-label dates before score access
training_and_scoring_rule.competition_domains: must be frozen from zero-label competition identities before score access

metrics.top1: conditional D Top1 accuracy diagnostic only
structural_audits: identity overlap equals zero against every frozen exclusion set

all_required: zero-label source/identity gate passes before numeric score access
at least two frozen time blocks each contain >=50 realized T>=7 events
at least three frozen competition domains contain realized T>=7 events
paired bootstrap 90% upper bound for pooled dLogLoss <0
both frozen time blocks have dLogLoss <0
strict majority of eligible competition domains have dLogLoss <0
frozen_confirmation_gate.decision: CONFIRMATION_PASS only if every required gate passes; otherwise CONFIRMATION_FAIL_PARK; coverage shortage uses STOP_COVERAGE_CONFIRMATION_LABELS_CONSUMED

stopping_rule: After any C077-B numeric confirmation labels are opened, do not tune C, feature set, interactions, per-T models, baseline alpha, time blocks, competition subset, bootstrap seed/confidence, coverage minima, identity exclusions or score mapping on those labels. A fail parks C077-B under this frozen representation.
